name: google
title: Google Search
description: Search Google from the panel with its suggestions as you type and a Wikipedia card for people, places and things. Add SerpApi, Brave Search or your own SearXNG to see answers and results right in the list.
author: pal

settings.label: Results from
settings.description: Where the web results come from. Suggestions come from Google with no key whatever this says; no free keyless service gives results reliably (DuckDuckGo, Bing's feed, Qwant, Mojeek and Startpage refuse or answer poorly without a browser).

settings.label: SerpApi key
settings.description: From serpapi.com/manage-api-key. The free plan is 250 searches a month: with it, set Show results to When I ask. A query asked again within the hour is served from SerpApi's cache and costs nothing.

settings.label: SearXNG instance
settings.description: Its address; `json` must be among the instance's search formats (settings.yml, search.formats).

settings.label: Show results
settings.description: As you type: the answer and the top five results join the list under the suggestions once you pause, and the pane previews a suggestion's (one request per query, cached). When I ask: only cmd+Enter searches.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: The language of the suggestions and results. Auto follows the system's.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: A two-letter country code for what is local (tr, us, de); empty follows the system.

settings.label: Open in
settings.description: The browser a search or a result opens in.

settings.label: At the root
settings.text: Suggestions under Search the web when nothing matches
settings.description: Asked only when nothing on the machine matched what you typed, so a query pal answered itself is never sent to Google.

settings.label: Recent searches
settings.text: Remember searches and list them while nothing is typed

store.tagline: Google suggestions, answers and results as you type
features: Google's suggestions as you type, no key needed; `enter` searches, `tab` takes a suggestion
A Wikipedia card in the side pane for a person, place or thing Google recognises
With SerpApi, Brave Search or SearXNG: instant answers and top results under the suggestions
`cmd+enter` lists every result as a row to open, open in the background or copy
Offered at the root when nothing else matches; your query leaves the machine only then
Recent searches before you type; language, region and safe search in Settings
